note: 21 upstream hook suggestions. Examples are fictional illustrations, never facts about the user. No performance guarantee.
rules: Choose a hook only when it fits the evidence and voice.
Make the opening understandable on its own.
Use real numbers only; no hook requires a number.
Do not force a marketing structure onto an ordinary observation.

hooks.name: Contrarian Take
hooks.template: Everyone says {common advice}. After {specific experience}, I think that is wrong.
hooks.example: Everyone says post daily. I posted 4x a week for a year and beat every daily poster in my niche.
hooks.best_for: Establishing a point of view. Treat as an editorial suggestion, not a measured ranking.
hooks.trap: Being contrarian about something nobody believes. The belief has to be genuinely common.

hooks.name: Number Reveal
hooks.template: I {did thing} for {N} {days/weeks}. Here is what actually happened.
hooks.example: I sent 400 cold DMs in 30 days. 11 replied. 2 became clients.
hooks.best_for: Experiments, challenges, anything with a countable result. Treat as an editorial suggestion, not a measured ranking.
hooks.trap: Burying the number. Put it in line 1 or the formula does nothing.

hooks.name: Mistake Confession
hooks.template: {Specific cost} is what {one mistake} cost me.
hooks.example: $18,000 is what not having a contract cost me last March.
hooks.best_for: Trust. Treat as an editorial suggestion, not a measured ranking.
hooks.trap: A fake-humble mistake. 'I care too much' reads as a brag and kills the post.

hooks.name: Before / After
hooks.template: {Time ago} I was {low state}. Today I {high state}. The difference was {one thing}.
hooks.example: 18 months ago I was writing proposals at 2am. Today I send them in 6 minutes. One template did it.
hooks.best_for: Proof you have travelled the distance your reader wants to travel. Treat as an editorial suggestion, not a measured ranking.
hooks.trap: Three-part transformations. Name one lever or the reader stops believing you.

hooks.name: The List Promise
hooks.template: {N} things I wish someone had told me before {milestone}.
hooks.example: 7 things I wish someone had told me before I hired my first employee.
hooks.best_for: Saves. Treat as an editorial suggestion, not a measured ranking.
hooks.trap: N above 10. The reader does not believe you have 15 good ones, and you do not.

hooks.name: Insider Secret
hooks.template: After {N} years {doing thing}, here is the part nobody puts in the {job posting/course/pitch}.
hooks.example: After 9 years in agency sales, here is the part nobody puts in the job posting.
hooks.best_for: Credentialed takes. Treat as an editorial suggestion, not a measured ranking.
hooks.trap: Promising a secret and delivering common knowledge. The comments will say so.

hooks.name: The Callout
hooks.template: If you are still {doing outdated thing}, stop.
hooks.example: If you are still writing your LinkedIn posts in the LinkedIn composer, stop.
hooks.best_for: Short posts with one instruction. Treat as an editorial suggestion, not a measured ranking.
hooks.trap: Calling out something nobody does. Or worse, calling out your own audience with contempt.

hooks.name: Question Trap
hooks.template: {Specific scenario with a real cost}. What do you do?
hooks.example: Your best client asks for a 40% discount and hints they will leave without it. What do you do?
hooks.best_for: Comment volume. Treat as an editorial suggestion, not a measured ranking.
hooks.trap: A question with an obvious right answer. There has to be a real fork.

hooks.name: Story Cold Open
hooks.template: "{Line of dialogue}"\n\n{Who said it, when, and why it mattered}.
hooks.example: "We are going with someone cheaper."\n\nThat email arrived 40 minutes after I sent my best proposal of the year.
hooks.best_for: Long-form storytelling posts. Treat as an editorial suggestion, not a measured ranking.
hooks.trap: Dialogue nobody would actually say. Use the real line, including the ugly parts.

hooks.name: The Receipt
hooks.template: {Screenshot or hard number}. {One sentence of context}.
hooks.example: 3 clients, 11 days, zero calls booked. Here is the exact sequence that did it.
hooks.best_for: Anything you can prove. Treat as an editorial suggestion, not a measured ranking.
hooks.trap: A receipt with no story attached. The number opens the door, the story is the room.

hooks.name: Myth Bust
hooks.template: {Popular explanation} is not why {bad outcome} is happening to you.
hooks.example: The algorithm is not why your posts are dying.
hooks.best_for: Reframing. Treat as an editorial suggestion, not a measured ranking.
hooks.trap: Busting the myth and never naming the replacement. Always name it.

hooks.name: The Comparison
hooks.template: {Expensive option} vs {cheap option}. {Surprising verdict}.
hooks.example: A $12,000 brand agency vs a $20 tool and a weekend. The weekend won.
hooks.best_for: Tool and process posts. Treat as an editorial suggestion, not a measured ranking.
hooks.trap: An unfair comparison. Concede what the expensive option genuinely does better.

hooks.name: Permission Slip
hooks.template: You are allowed to {thing the reader feels guilty about}.
hooks.example: You are allowed to turn down work that pays well and makes you miserable.
hooks.best_for: Reach beyond your niche. Treat as an editorial suggestion, not a measured ranking.
hooks.trap: Generic self-care. It has to be specific to the working life of your reader.

hooks.name: Pattern Interrupt
hooks.template: {One word or three-word line, full stop.}
hooks.example: I got fired.
hooks.best_for: Stopping the scroll cold. Treat as an editorial suggestion, not a measured ranking.
hooks.trap: Overuse. Once a month. Every post starting this way reads as a tic.

hooks.name: The Warning
hooks.template: {Common practice} is quietly costing you {specific thing they care about}.
hooks.example: Your 'quick call to align' is quietly costing you six hours a week.
hooks.best_for: Problem-aware audiences who have not connected cause to cost. Treat as an editorial suggestion, not a measured ranking.
hooks.trap: Fear with no exit. Give the fix in the same post or you have just made someone anxious.

hooks.name: Good vs Great
hooks.template: Good {role} {do X}. Great {role} {do Y}.
hooks.example: Good salespeople answer the question. Great salespeople ask why it was asked.
hooks.best_for: Quotable one-liners. Treat as an editorial suggestion, not a measured ranking.
hooks.trap: A distinction that is really just 'try harder'. Y has to be a different action, not more effort.

hooks.name: Time Anchor
hooks.template: {Task} used to take me {long time}. It now takes {short time}.
hooks.example: Writing a week of posts used to take me 5 hours. It now takes 20 minutes.
hooks.best_for: Tool, system and automation posts. Treat as an editorial suggestion, not a measured ranking.
hooks.trap: An unbelievable ratio. 5 hours to 20 minutes lands. 5 hours to 8 seconds does not.

hooks.name: The Unpopular Rule
hooks.template: I do not {widely accepted practice}. Ever. Here is why.
hooks.example: I do not take discovery calls. Ever.
hooks.best_for: Positioning. Treat as an editorial suggestion, not a measured ranking.
hooks.trap: A rule you break constantly. Someone in the comments will know.

hooks.name: Curiosity Gap
hooks.template: The {superlative} {thing} I ever {verb} {broke the obvious rule}.
hooks.example: The best hire I ever made failed the interview.
hooks.best_for: Openers that force the 'see more' tap. Treat as an editorial suggestion, not a measured ranking.
hooks.trap: A gap you never close. Pay it off by line 4 or you have written clickbait.

hooks.name: The Walk-Away
hooks.template: I {fired/quit/deleted/cancelled} {valuable thing}. {Result}.
hooks.example: I fired my highest-paying client in January. Revenue is up 30%.
hooks.best_for: Values posts with a business result attached. Treat as an editorial suggestion, not a measured ranking.
hooks.trap: Walking away with no cost. Name what it actually cost you or it reads as theatre.

hooks.name: The Direct Value
hooks.template: Here is the exact {artifact} I used to {specific outcome}. Steal it.
hooks.example: Here is the exact 4-line email I used to reopen 3 dead deals. Steal it.
hooks.best_for: Lead magnets and comment-for-link posts. Treat as an editorial suggestion, not a measured ranking.
hooks.trap: Making them ask for something you could have just posted. Give the artifact away in the post.
